mapper.select: SELECT emp02_others_id AS others_id, emp01_person_id AS person_id, emp02_chn_nm AS chn_name, emp02_eng_nm AS eng_name, to_decrypts(emp02_ctz_no) AS dec_ctz_no, emp02_birthday AS birthday, emp02_lunar_cd AS lunar_code, emp02_gender_cd AS gender_code, emp02_nat_cd AS nation_code, emp02_email_other AS email_other, emp02_military_cd AS military_code, emp02_family_dscr AS family_dscr, emp02_marriage_cd AS marriage_code, emp02_zip_cd AS zip_code, emp02_zip_addr AS zip_address, emp02_addr_detail AS zip_detail, emp02_home_telno AS home_tel_no, emp02_note AS note, emp02_hire_date_group AS hire_date_group, emp02_hire_date_leave_calc AS hire_date_leave_calc FROM emp01_person LEFT OUTER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId}
